Parallel read includes reader setup and newly opened SQLite connection caches; its cache setting is per connection. Settle is explicit engine maintenance. CRUD scans consume full values; SQLite copies columns into Go buffers, AptevaDB/Pebble expose borrowed callbacks. Read phases repeat the same shuffled order. Update changes 10% of values, mixed is 80% point reads/20% updates, delete removes the updated 10%. Checks validate hit values, deletion, scan row counts and first/last-byte sums.
